events.title: Black Screen Issue Fixed
events.summary: We've fixed a black screen issue that some players encountered when launching the game. This was caused by differences in operating systems across certain regions.If you still run into this or any similar problem after the update, please don't hesitate to reach out to the developer. We're always keeping an eye on player feedback and will do our best to help.Thank you for your patience and support!

events.title: 🔥 Limited-time demo now open early | We're joining Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello, fellow players! We're delighted to announce that the limited-time demo for Witch's Atelier has launched early for the New Release Festival, and it will remain open until the festival ends.The main demo takes about 30 minutes to play through. After the prologue's main story ends, you're still free to explore—there's no forced ending. events.title: First Playtest Has Concluded – Thank You for Your Support!
events.summary: Hello everyone,Our first playtest for Witch's Atelier officially came to a close on August 30 at 00:00, and we're happy to say it was a wonderful journey!During this playtest, nearly 100 players joined us in exploring the game. Many of you took the time to fill out feedback forms, report bugs, and share thoughtful suggestions on gameplay polish, UX details, level pacing, and more.
